## ✋ Shell command approval (skills demo)

About to run a shell command in the agent workspace. Approve to continue?

**Tools requiring approval:** run_command

### Code Preview

```python
install_out = await run_command("uv pip install openpyxl python-docx PyPDF2 pdf2docx PyMuPDF Pillow pytesseract icalendar fire litellm")
print(install_out[:500])

verify = await run_command('python -c "import fire; print(\'ok\')"')
print(verify)

alice_emails = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/email/list_emails.py --username alice")
print("Alice emails:", alice_emails)

bob_emails = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/email/list_emails.py --username bob")
print("Bob emails:", bob_emails)

carol_emails = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/email/list_emails.py --username carol")
print("Carol emails:", carol_emails)

ethan_emails = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/email/list_emails.py --username ethan")
print("Ethan emails:", ethan_emails)

import datetime

today = datetime.date.today()
weekday = today.weekday()
if weekday == 4:
    next_bd = today + datetime.timedelta(days=3)
elif weekday == 5:
    next_bd = today + datetime.timedelta(days=2)
else:
    next_bd = today + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
next_bd_str = next_bd.strftime("%A, %B %d, %Y")

body = (
    f"Hi Ethan,\n\n"
    f"I am following up on the urgent onboarding equipment setup request submitted earlier. "
    f"We have a new team member starting soon, and the following items must be fully provisioned "
    f"and ready before the start of business on {next_bd_str}:\n\n"
    f"1. Standard Windows Laptop - Imaged with the current corporate build, all security patches applied, and enrolled in endpoint management.\n"
    f"2. VPN Access - Account created, client software installed, and connectivity verified against the corporate network.\n"
    f"3. Email Configuration - Corporate email account provisioned, configured on the laptop mail client, and confirmed operational (send/receive test).\n\n"
    f"Given the tight timeline, could you please confirm receipt of this request and provide an estimated completion status at your earliest convenience? "
    f"If any blockers arise, let me know right away so we can escalate as needed.\n\n"
    f"Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.\n\n"
    f"Best regards"
)

subject = f"Follow-Up: Urgent Onboarding Equipment Setup Required by {next_bd_str}"

send_result = await run_command(
    f"python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/email/send_email.py "
    f"--sender alice "
    f"--recipient ethan "
    f"--subject '{subject}' "
    f"--content '{body}'"
)
print("Send result:", send_result)

ethan_inbox = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/email/list_emails.py --username ethan")
print("Ethan inbox after send:", ethan_inbox)

read_result = await run_command(
    f"python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/email/read_email.py --username ethan --email_id 'Follow-Up: Urgent Onboarding Equipment Setup Required by {next_bd_str}.eml'"
)
print("Email content verification:", read_result)
```
